notes.title: Update Notes October 25
notes.notes:
Hello players
This update is a small bug fix update, change log below

Graphical error fixes
Asset optimization
Clarified how the saves worked
Fixed some spelling errors, and changed some translation errors

notes.title: Multilingual and Sound update
notes.notes:
Languages available in the are the following;
 Czech, Danish Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese Romanian, Spanish, Swedish.

Sound Changes
The walking sound
The interact sounds
Some of the enemy sound
Elevator Sound
Random world SFX
and more
[Sounds may be altered in the future/i]

Other Changes
Now collecting all of the achievements unlocks the bonus content

notes.title: Monthly update blog
notes.notes: This update has changed the health system, now instead of a health bar players will have the screen quickly change colors to indicate damage dealt. There are a few new cut scenes and animations in the game now and the difficulty of the game has increased. Also, a new main menu has been added, where you can test game settings in the main menu. Also, there is somewhat of controller support, except in the menu but playing through the game controller does work.

notes.title: Big Update!!!
notes.notes:
This game has been worked on for a while now and its almost finished, I’m working on the ending at the moment. I still plan on having the game released at the end of October.
Anyone who has a key please play test and report any bugs that there might be.
